description.text: Main Courses Engineering Economics,Computer Usage,Engineering Graphics,Test and Control Technology,Strength of Materials,Machine Design Production Planning and Control Electrical and Electronics Production and Manufacturing System. duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at Ningbo University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.
